## Description

ENCOUNTER aggregate (tenant, facility, patient, lead clinician, appointment, status, started_at, authority_mode = medvya), created when the doctor calls the patient in / starts the consultation. Board state "In consult" and Today reflect it. Identity banner component bound to the encounter (name, age, sex, MRN, DOB, allergies, consent state, encounter date/room).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Starting a consult creates exactly one active encounter for the appointment; a second start reuses it (idempotent).
- [ ] **AC2.** Every clinical screen in P2 shows the identity banner for the bound encounter; switching patient requires closing or explicitly leaving the encounter.
- [ ] **AC3.** Encounter start/end events update the reception board within 2 seconds.
- [ ] **AC4.** Encounter APIs require the clinician relationship/purpose policy (MDV-P2-024).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
